Hon'ble Raj Beer Singh,J.
1. Heard Sri Krishna Kant Dubey, learned counsel for the applicant, learned A.G.A. for the State and
perused the record.

2. The present bail application has been filed on behalf of the applicant in case crime No. 582/2022,
under Sections 498A, 304B, 201 Ipc and Section 3/4 D.P. Act, police station Dhaulana, District
Hapur with the prayer to enlarge the applicant on bail.

sentences.text: 3.  It has been argued by learned counsel for the applicant that the applicant-accused is innocent and he has not committed any offence.
Applicant is brother-in-law (Jeth) of deceased.
The marriage of deceased with brother of applicant has taken place on 25.07.2022.

The allegations of dowry demand and harassment of deceased levelled against the applicant are wholly false and in fact their marriage Kameshwar Sharma vs State Of U.P. on 16 April, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/178871342/
1 had been solemnized at a temple in Bihar.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: It was submitted that deceased has committed suicide on 29.12.2022 due to some minor issue with her husband and after that she was cremated.
Statement of husband of deceased was referred, wherein he has inter-alia stated that his wife has committed suicide and at the instance of some villagers, cremation was done.
Applicant, being brother-in-law (Jeth) of deceased, has no concern with the matrimonial life of deceased and her husband.

Lastly, it was submitted that the applicant is in judicial custody since 24.07.2023, having no criminal history,
and that in case applicant is enlarged on bail, the applicant will not misuse the liberty of bail.
4.
Learned A.G.A. has opposed the prayer for bail.

5. Considering the submissions of learned counsel for the parties, nature of accusations, period of custody and all attending facts and circumstances of the case, without expressing any opinion on the merits, a case for bail is made out.
Hence, the bail application is hereby allowed.

6. Let the applicant Kameshwar Sharma involved in the aforesaid crime be released on bail on furnishing a personal bond and two local sureties each of the like amount to the satisfaction of court concerned subject to the following conditions:
i. The applicant will not tamper with the evidence during trial.
ii.
The applicant will not pressurize/intimidate the prosecution witnesses.
iii. The applicant will appear before the trial court on the date fixed, unless personal presence is exempted.
iv. The applicant will not try to contact, threat or otherwise influence the complainant or any of the witness of the case.
7. In case of breach of any of the above condition, the court concerned shall be at liberty to cancel the bail of applicant, in accordance with law.
